newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: UAE, French chiefs of staff hold talks.
newsitem.headline: UAE, French chiefs of staff hold talks.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates and French armed forces chiefs of staff held talks on Tuesday, the official WAM news agency reported.
It said Sheikh Mohammed bin Zaid al-Nahayan, also the UAE's leading arms procurement officer, met Jean-Philippe Douin and discussed cooperation and military issues of mutual interest.
Lockheed Martin Corp of the United States and France's Dassault Aviation are remaining bidders for a deal to sell the UAE up to 80 long-range strike aircraft worth up to $6 billion.
